title: Appendix A — Sleep Quality Proposal
text: Our project will explore the relationship between sleep quality and lifestyle factors, with a focus on caffeine consumption and screen time. We will investigate whether these factors are associated with differences in sleep duration and perceived sleep quality, and identify any notable patterns or relationships in the data.

title: Appendix A — Sleep Quality Proposal
text:
Research Questions

What lifestyle factors are most strongly associated with sleep quality? How are caffeine consumption and screen time related to sleep duration and quality? Do sleep patterns and quality differ across people with different lifestyle habits?

title: Appendix A — Sleep Quality Proposal
text:
Motivations

As college students, we are part of a demographic that often struggles to get enough sleep. We were interested in exploring how common lifestyle factors, such as caffeine consumption and screen time, may contribute to sleep quality.
